session.name: SeedVR2 image path measured; both runtime workflows shipped, app wiring deferred to 1.5

goal.original: Test the SeedVR2 IMAGE path on the bench with color_correction_method set to lab, then convert both SeedVR2 workflows into repo runtime files under comfy_workflows/ - ready to wire but NOT wired. Widened mid-session by Fabio: 3B, 7B and 7B Sharp must ALL be available for both image and video upscaling.
goal.summary: Research is finished and the two runtime workflows are committed and proven to execute. What remains on MPI-506 is the app half - a plugin-contributes-a-dropdown-entry mechanism that does not exist yet - plus two open gates (a --lowvram fpc re-measure and the remote/Pod question). MPI-507 is small but blocked on that same mechanism.

completed: IMAGE path measured: no chunker exists there, so no VRAM sizing is needed at all. Every variant ran at every multiplier, including 7B at 4x (13.17 Mpx single frame, 63.1s, no OOM).

7B and 7B Sharp VIDEO both work - answers open question 1. fpc 57 OOMs on 7B; 37 runs clean on both. The drop was PREDICTED from the weight delta before it was measured: (8.33-3.46)/(0.55*1.85) = 4.8 latents lost, 15 -> 10 -> fpc 37. Exact.

3B control at the same fpc 37 removed the chunk/model confound: chunk size costs 12 percent, the model gap is 1.9x, and 7B costs 45 percent more wall clock to restore less at 1.5x. 3B stays the default on BOTH paths.

color_correction lab confirmed on images too: max drift 6.86 -> 1.12, an 84 percent cut for a 2 percent sharpness cost. Video drift peaked at 36, so most of that was manufactured by chunk accumulation, not by the model.
denoise settled and CLOSED by Fabio: quantised by int(steps/denoise), so at steps=1 everything above ~0.67 is a no-op (0.75 was byte-identical to 1.0). Ships at 1.0, never exposed.

Alpha settled: JoinImageWithAlpha is a pass-through, not a mask. Nothing is protected from restoration. A fully-opaque RGBA source is bit-identical to plain RGB, but a transparent region shifts the whole frame because Pillow's RGBA lanczos zeroes the RGB underneath.

Three graph defects found and fixed BEFORE export: two VHS_VideoCombine nodes that were real OUTPUT nodes and executed, an orphan VAEDecode, and frames_per_chunk sitting as a bare widget the app could never inject.

comfy_workflows/seedvr2_image.json (14 nodes) and seedvr2_video.json (19 nodes) committed as 57c92ae9 - converted against :48188, gated by validate-injection-rules.mjs, and EXECUTED (image 15.1s, video 397.4s).
MpiNodes pin verified: local pack HEAD equals the pinned fe812d47, so the graphs encode exactly the node schema users get.
pending: Build the plugin-contributes-a-dropdown-entry mechanism. PluginDef has a SINGULAR operation and one instance today; three SeedVR2 plugins all serve videoUpscale, so operation no longer identifies a plugin.
Per-entry conditional controls: SeedVR2 declares NONE, PiD declares prompt + denoise. A declared list on the entry, never an if (isPid) branch - both consumers exist on day one.
Three PLUGINS entries + four deps (3 weights + 1 shared VAE), and 20.62 GB uploaded to R2 with sha256s.
GATE: re-measure frames_per_chunk under --lowvram on :48188. Every number so far is NORMAL_VRAM bench and the app launches --lowvram on every NVIDIA GPU.
GATE: settle the remote/Pod half. A plugin dep is not baked into the Pod image; nobody has established how image-describer's encoder reaches a Pod.
STILL UNAPPROVED across three sessions: append the three generator traps to docs/workflow-authoring/generator-patterns.md.
PROPOSED, not approved: document the sync-raw-workflows.mjs dirty-guard fallback in docs/workflow-authoring/README.md.

next_action.description: MPI-506's remaining work is the APP half and it is a feature, not wiring - do not start it expecting a quick job. Read brief 2g/2h/2i and checklist.md first. The single blocking design piece is the plugin-contributes-a-dropdown-entry mechanism: PluginDef (js/data/pluginsRegistry.js) has a singular `operation` and exactly one instance, and three SeedVR2 plugins all serve videoUpscale, so `operation` stops identifying a plugin. MpiToolOptionsUpscale.js is ALREADY kind-aware ('image' | 'video'), so no refactor is needed there. Before any frames_per_chunk number reaches the app, re-measure under --lowvram on :48188 - every number on the card is NORMAL_VRAM bench - and remember 2h proved the number must vary per SELECTED VARIANT, not just per free VRAM. Also settle the remote/Pod half (brief section 5) before coding, because a plugin dep is not baked into the Pod image.

key_decisions: 1.5, NOT 1.4 (Fabio, 2026-08-10). Research and workflows land now; app wiring does not. Verified rather than asserted: grep across js/ and routes/ returns ZERO references to either workflow file and no seedvr2 dep entries exist.
All three variants ship for BOTH image and video (Fabio, 2026-08-10). This answered open question 1 and added a 7B video bench that had never been run.

3B is the default on both paths, now measured rather than inherited from community consensus. 7B is conservative at small multipliers (5.28x vs 3B's 8.88x at image x2, 1.90x vs 3.57x at video 1.5x) and only leads at x4 (16.87x vs 10.93x).
denoise ships at 1.0 and is never exposed - Fabio, after his own test plus the measured quantisation.

The honest continuous fidelity knob, if one is ever wanted, is NOT denoise: blend SeedVR2PostProcessing's output against the resized original with core ImageBlend, driven by an Input_Strength MpiFloat. Proposed, not built.
A deprecation card for PiD was researched and then explicitly NOT created - Fabio is giving it to another agent (2026-08-10). The research is in this handoff's constraints so it is not redone.
constraints: DO NOT IMPLEMENT IN THE APP. No js/, no routes/. Workflows in comfy_workflows/ are fine; wiring them is 1.5.

sync-raw-workflows.mjs REFUSES to run while any generated workflow is dirty, and nine of them are permanently dirty on this box from the core.autocrlf renormalisation (content-identical to HEAD, git diff --numstat empty). The working path is to drive its steps 3 and 4 directly: node scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs <raw file> > <runtime file> with COMFY_URL set to the ENGINE, then node scripts/validate-injection-rules.mjs on the outputs. Do not try to 'fix' the nine files; unpicking that needs a banned git command.
Convert against :48188, NEVER the :8188 bench - the bench runs ahead and has silently shifted a widget before.

Two shell traps bit this session and both fail SILENTLY: a heredoc is blocked by guard-shell, and BACKTICKS inside a double-quoted python -c string are command-substituted away, which silently ate every `code span` from two files before it was caught. Write a .py file and run it by path.

Dumping a co-owned JSON with ensure_ascii=False re-escapes the WHOLE file and produced a huge false diff on board.json. Re-dump from git show HEAD:<path> with ensure_ascii=True to keep the diff minimal.
SHARED TREE and busy. Peers own MPI-504, js/data/modelConstants/models.js, a peer handoff, one open message and 10 pending_file_states - none overlapping this card. Commit by explicit pathspec only.
ASK FABIO BEFORE ANY GENERATION when another agent may be sharing the GPU. He gave a green flag for this session's matrix.

PiD DEPRECATION RESEARCH, handed to another agent, recorded so it is not redone: a `deprecated: true` flag already exists but ONLY on operations, in js/core/operationRegistry.js, and it means 'old history items still validate, nothing may write this key again' - it is invisible to users and its only reader is scripts/release-health-check.mjs. Models have no flag at all; deprecation there is a `// DEPRECATED (MPI-nnn)` comment convention. PiD is a real ModelDef, id nvidia-pid, type pid, supportedOps ['pid'], at js/data/modelConstants/models.js:820, and its `pid` op key is NOT deprecated today. On removal, NEVER delete the pid-* / vae-* / pid-gemma dep entries - _orphanedDepIds iterates DEPS and the entry surviving is what lets a user reclaim the weight.

CHANGELOG CONTRADICTION for whoever takes that card: docs/releases/UNRELEASED.md line ~250 carries 'The NVIDIA PiD upscaler now actually upscales' for 1.4.0. Marking PiD deprecated in the same release would ship both claims at once. Latest release is 1.3.1, so 1.4.0 is still unreleased and that entry is editable.
